selection_methodology.source_catalogue: data/k_rera_extraction.sqlite (4,459 Bengaluru Urban application rows; 4,094 APPROVED rows)
selection_methodology.deterministic_selection_rule: Deterministic stratified midpoint-distance scoring across 12 (page_band x project_type) cells over the 3,969 eligible APPROVED rows, ordered by ascending (page_number, row_order).
stratification_dimensions: Catalogue page bands: Early (Pages 1-100: 83), Middle (Pages 101-300: 84), Late (Pages 301-446: 83)
Project types: Residential/Group Housing (120), Plotted Development (60), Commercial (35), Mixed Development (35)
Promoter diversity: 246 distinct promoters across 250 selected projects
Execution grouping: 10 internal sub-batches of 25 projects each (Sub-Batches 1..10)
Note: This controlled 250-project stratified sample is designed for repeatability and scale validation; statistical representativeness of the full catalogue is not claimed.
